scope: exploratory retrospective experiment on previously examined CARE Farm A; not independent external validation
hypothesis: past temperature residual trends, persistence and joint deviations add predictive information about a canonical annotated event within the next 24 hours
baseline: care-personal-normal-h24-v1; frozen per-source past-normal regressors and calibration, no regressor refitting
features: per-channel current normalized residual, trailing means 3/6, population std 6, OLS slope 6 in residual units/hour, fraction z>=1 over 6, delta 1 hour; current maximum/second-largest positive residual and count z>=1; delayed regime wind, ambient, power, generator speed, rotor speed
gap_policy: reset at a timestamp gap, source change or fewer than two finite channel residuals; channel windows require complete finite values
validation_rule: next asset in fixed cyclic order after outer test asset; other three assets train the supervised head
preprocessing: training assets only: median imputation, StandardScaler; identities, roles, status and future labels excluded from feature matrix
labels: reuse canonical H24 labels, competing-fault censoring and physical deduplication from reviewed h24_reproduction_v1; unknown labels never treated as negative
threshold_policy: validation only: maximize new-event recall under both normal budgets, then minimize normal warning fraction and episode frequency, then maximize known-point precision; disable warnings if no feasible validation event hit
event_success: new observed below-to-above crossing in [annotated anchor-24h, annotated anchor); left-censored high starts reported separately
denominator: all 11 canonical events, including unavailable predictions
promotion_gate: strictly more than four detected events, no more than 2 false normal episodes/720h and 5% normal warning time; no material loss of availability; independent holdout still required before claiming generalization
score_semantics: uncalibrated binary score for annotated event within next 24h; not a calibrated failure probability or future sensor forecast
historical_baseline_assumption: same-source certified normal history is retrospectively available before each prediction partition; annotation creation times and cross-source absolute chronology cannot be established
